item.text:
Added React view transitions to the gallery. Each product thumbnail and its detail image share a product-specific transition name, so the image can morph between the two views. Product links use a forward transition type, and the back link uses a backward type for directional page slides. Suspense boundaries now fade from skeleton to content when they reveal; reduced-motion preferences suppress those animations and the skeleton pulse.

TypeScript and the production build pass. I also checked the rendered markup to confirm that the thumbnail and detail image receive matching transition names. I could not visually verify the animation in a browser in this environment.
